content.text: In regions where payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are ineffective, digital creators face significant barriers. Countries like Nigeria and Kenya often restrict access to essential e-commerce tools, leaving creators to struggle with outdated payment methods. COREMERCH offers a solution with infrastructure that ensures autonomy and efficiency. This guide outlines how to create a fully functional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-step-step-deployment-5|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] store using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-18|Cloudflare R2]]-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles-6|cloudflare]] Pages, without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The digital marketplace is evolving, yet many creators are locked out due to regional restrictions imposed by traditional payment processors. By leveraging infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages, you gain not only a robust hosting solution but also control over your data and transactions. This architecture allows you to bypass the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, ensuring that you can operate your store seamlessly and independently. COREMERCH enables you to deploy a system that is inherently resistant to the issues faced by users of legacy systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment, gather the necessary components: a Cloudflare account, a Google account for Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with GitHub Pages for hosting your site and understand basic concepts of web development. Ensure you have at least five digital products ready for upload, as this will simplify your initial setup and testing process. Prepare your product files and any relevant documentation to streamline the deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processing with NOWPayments to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies. Set up webhook notifications to trigger when a payment is confirmed. Next, use Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, including order confirmations and file delivery. Ensure that your product files are stored in a reliable location, such as Google Drive, to facilitate quick access and delivery to customers post-purchase. Thoroughly test this pipeline to ensure each element works together seamlessly.
Own your infrastructure; no dependencies on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery systems are configured, conduct a series of tests to confirm that everything operates as expected. Use a test cryptocurrency to simulate transactions, ensuring that your site processes payments and delivers products correctly. After confirming successful test transactions, launch your store. Promote your new crypto store to your audience by sharing the link to your products page, such as https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, to start generating sales immediately.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your store, focus on scaling operations. Monitor transaction volumes and customer interactions to identify any potential bottlenecks. Consider expanding your product offerings or enhancing your site’s features based on customer feedback. Utilize the Edge Commerce Stack for more advanced configurations, allowing for additional product listings and improved backend capabilities. This infrastructure ensures that as your business grows, it remains fast and reliable.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploy quickly and efficiently—Stack 02 is ready in 48 hours.

This can significantly enhance your infrastructure's capabilities while you navigate the complexities of online sales.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
